newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. will not tolerate Japan deficit rise - Medley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. will not tolerate Japan deficit rise - Medley.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury will not tolerate an increase in the structural trade deficit with Japan, Richard Medley, president of Medley Investment Group, told Reuters on Wednesday in an interview.
"The treasury is growing concerned with the dollar at current levels, and above this level they will start to vocalise their concerns," he said.
He cited Federal Reserve Vice Chair Alice Rivlin's reported comments on the dollar last week. Her comments raised concerns that the U.S. administration's tolerance for a higher dollar may be limited.
Medley also thought Japanese stocks were far better valued than government bonds and recommended land as a good investment.
"I do think stocks are a good investment at this point but you have to be a medium-term holder," he said.
